claims.claim: Post-TASK selection authenticates the current canonical TASK revision, reuses Brain Sync and Unified State lifecycle facts, and distinguishes fresh TASK from admitted ACTIVE RUN.

Exact terminal wake selectors authenticate canonical refs and RUN/TASK/revision/head/affinity bindings; stale, substituted, conflicting or incomplete sources return typed blockers without foreign RUN attribution.
RESULT, independent REVIEW and publication inclusion remain distinct; RESULT without REVIEW stays SEMANTIC_REVIEW, and unpublished PASS remains separate from DONE.
The projection exposes source-bound candidate, artifact, review-decision and published-source SHAs, with explicit nulls and reasons for unproven data.
FAILURE exports one exact handoff to the existing bounded diagnostic reader; ordinary RESULT and DONE require no raw-log crawl, and no protected path is exported.
Portable output is bounded and redacted, carries a request-scoped witness, rechecks source currentness, rejects substitution and returns typed unavailable-source blockers.
The maintained post-task CLI and additive Work Context selector consume the projection; real Git subprocess fixtures cover exact TASK and terminal wakes in detached checkouts with protected files.

Regression fixtures cover RESULT through publication, artifact-only dirty FAILURE, fresh/ACTIVE state, forged and competing sources, moved refs, stale wakes, incomplete REVIEW and misleading carrier selectors.

Production changes add observational reads without lifecycle writers or dispatch authority; legacy selector branches and state CLI output are preserved, and historical data and roadmap remain unchanged.
